profile.headline: Software Engineer at M&T Bank
profile.summary:
Highly motivated Business Intelligence Professional in SQL Server 2005 and Microsoft Technologies with excellent data analysis and database implementation experience including major fundraising database conversions resulting in improved business processes.  Proficiency in ETL (extract/transform/load) methodologies combining internal and external databases to develop actionable business reports.  Demonstrated teamwork skills and the ability to accomplish tasks with minimal direction and supervision.

Specialties: Business Intelligence Developer, Conversions, Data Integration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Develop stored procedures to process the bank's daily account data.
* Implement performance tuning for slow running queries.
* Developed a report to show account performance over multiple periods.
* Implemented a procedure to process retroactive price adjustments.
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Microsoft SQL Server · Visual Studio · Database Design · Git · Jira

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Database development.  Writing SSIS packages, stored procedures, and SSRS reports.

positions.title: Crystal Guru
positions.description: The Blackbaud User Society is a group of expert and advanced users of Blackbaud software, particularly the Raiser's Edge, that have gotten together to share their wisdom and expertise.
